t: This is the Queen Victoria Monument, a memorial column in Kensington, and Victoria is depicted on it. She was Queen of the United Kingdom from 1837 until her death in 1901. Her reign of sixty-three years was longer than any before it, and it defined the Victorian era, a time of industrial, political, scientific and military change, with a great expansion of the British Empire. In 1876 Parliament also made her Empress of India.
